function: KPP-native authoring of Anchor design and recipe proposals, append-only obligation extension, and exact UTF-8 Python source transport through EMIT_TEXT/0.2.
capabilities: Canonical BlackHole/Neutral/WhiteHole design applications through existing mantleos.anchors
KPP recipe/4 and anchor.design/1 validation without a second registry
Append-only requirement extension with earlier obligation preservation
Python-as-literal transport using the existing KPP EMIT_TEXT/0.2 runtime and bridge
Native inspection and explicit unverified/Baker-pending review output
Native KPP full-contract Oven work packet using existing anchor_design renderer
Native structural and transport qualification with runtime and artifact fingerprints
Byte-compiled UTF-8/LF source transport with exact readback and native profile inspection
adaptation: Optional Oven companion. Requires a reviewed spec and the shared KPP/MantleOS runtime. Use host-controlled output paths, native Satisfaction for candidate evidence, and separate Baker acceptance.
verified_with: AnchorForge 0.3.0 release tests on installed KPP 1.1.0a5 at 4fd2aef58c8f965ff1a96e3037ac196ed0d11c79. See release-evidence/anchorforge-organ-0.3.0.json for platform and counter Satisfaction evidence.
provenance: Revised from AnchorForge 0.2; qualification uses the pinned KPP source revision and local reviewed counter fixtures.

usage.use_when: An LLM/Oven must quickly turn scoped requirements into canonical KPP Anchor design and optionally package Python source as an actual supported .anchor carrier.
inputs: Reviewed authoring spec or existing recipe plus new obligations
usage.limits: Readiness covers the stated authoring and Python transport contract at the tested KPP revision. Recipe fitness, user application behavior, and host authority require their own evidence and review. UTF-8/LF Python only.
